questions.stem: All of the following are true, except?

options.label: A
options.text: NADPH oxidase acts via superoxide ions

options.label: B
options.text: Chediak-Higashi syndrome is due to defective phagolysosome formation

options.label: C
options.text: Chronic Granulomatous Disease is due to a defect in the LYST gene

options.label: D
options.text: Myeloperoxidase action is mainly due to OCI-

questions.answerText: Chronic Granulomatous Disease is due to a defect in the LYST gene
questions.solutionHtml:
Chronic Granulomatous Disease is due to a defect in the LYST gene

Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 241

questions.stem: A 7-year-old child presents with a complaint of pain in the throat; the pain worsens while swallowing. Diagnosed with acute pharyngitis. Which of the following is incorrect?

options.label: A
options.text: Neutrophils will be first to arrive at the lesion

options.label: D
options.text: If group A beta-hemolytic bacteria are present, it may cause rheumatic fever

questions.solutionHtml:
Granuloma will be present
  • As it is an acute condition, granuloma will not be formed.
  • Granuloma is seen in chronic inflammation.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 99-101

questions.stem: A 7-month-old boy presented with a two-day history of fever and abscess over the neck. The mother reveals that the child had similar recurrent infections in the past. The result of the nitroblue tetrazolium dye reduction test was abnormal. Which is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml:
Chronic granulomatous disease
  • The given clinical history and abnormal nitroblue tetrazolium dye reduction test most likely suggest chronic granulomatous disease.
  • The condition usually manifests with recurrent pyogenic infections with catalase-positive organisms in the first year of life.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 241
